newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Charoen Pokphand to invest more in China.
newsitem.headline: Thai Charoen Pokphand to invest more in China.

text.p: Thai conglomerate Charoen Pokphand said on Thursday it would continue to invest in China despite the death of its paramount leader Deng Xiaoping.

"We believe that there are good opportunities for joint-ventures and investments in China and we will continue to pursue them, confident that the signs for the future are all positive," said Thirayuth Phitya-Isarakul, president of CP Agro-Industry Business Group.
"We have great confidence in our investments in China. Deng has left clear directions concerning the political and economic future of the country,' he added in a statement.
The CP Group, which has wide-ranging business interests, has many long-term investments in China worth more than 50 billion baht ($2 billion).
